descriptionHtml:
Fantech Kanata S VX9S Gaming Mouse Pink Edition (High-Precision Optical Gaming Sensor / Adjustable Up to 7200 DPI / 10 Million Clicks Switch Lifespan / 6 Programmable Buttons / Dynamic RGB Backlighting / Ergonomic Lightweight Body / 1-Year Official Agent Warranty)

Gain competitive accuracy and elevate your battle station aesthetics with the Fantech Kanata S VX9S Gaming Mouse in Pink Edition, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Official Agent Warranty (ضمان سنة من الوكيل). Designed with an ergonomic lightweight shell for fatigue-free gaming, the VX9S Pink features an optical gaming sensor with adjustable DPI settings up to 7200 DPI, long-lasting switches rated for 10 million clicks, 6 responsive programmable buttons, smooth PTFE mouse feet, and vibrant RGB lighting effects.
